headline: Every 3x3 one-null-leaf target A=[[r,a,c],[a,0,0],[c,0,b]] whose entire spectrum satisfies |lambda|>=1 has global cap-one product density norm <=2+log4=3.38629..., a fixed 0.85635... below the source-valid 3sqrt2 obstruction. Near-maximal partner certificates rigidly collapse to the hyperbolic-pair-plus-square block.
proved_implications: For the scoped 3x3 target, A^2-I is PSD, hence |a|,|b|>=1, c^2<=(a^2-1)(b^2-1) in absolute-value notation, and r^2<=(a^2-1)(a^2+c^2-1).
Applying account02/B17 gives ||p||_infty<=2+log4 for arbitrary independent density-cap-one inputs.
If the partner certificate approaches 2+log4, then |a|,|b|->1 and r,c->0.
For A_delta=[[delta,1+delta,delta],[1+delta,0,0],[delta,0,1+delta]], all eigenvalue magnitudes exceed one and ||p||_infty<=(2+log4)/(1+delta).
For iid centered unit intervals, Q=2xXY+yZ^2 has exact global norm (2+log(2x/y))/x for y<=2x and 2sqrt2/sqrt(xy) for y>=2x; target maximum is 2+log2.

partner_result_applied.application: Global inequality ||p_{X^T A_delta X}||_infty <= (2+log4)/(1+delta), including delta=0.1 bound 3.078449419199901...

scope_guard: A^2-I>=0 is used only for a 3x3 matrix whose entire spectrum is outside (-1,1); it is not inferred from the ambient at-least-three-large-eigenvalues hypothesis.
unresolved_next: Attack the first class that destroys the exact null leaf: add Y^2 or YZ, or treat several shared/intermediate-leverage rows; keep high-dimensional diffuse/multiscale and off-zero two-sheet mechanisms live.
